geometry_notes: The building is a 4-storey tower and a 2-storey L-shaped wing. The tower is the clean rectangle (671.8,514.3) (689.5,479.2) (717.6,493.4) (699.9,528.6), flat roof at 18.7 m (lidar 18.7). The lidar's 19.7 m tier at its E side is the same flat roof (drainage crickets or snow), not a step. The 18.7/9.7 massing outline zig-zags along the tower's NE side ((717.3,494.4) (708.9,509.3) (707.1,505.5) (711.5,499.5) ...): it should be the straight line U1.

The wing (lidar 9.7 m) wraps the tower's SE and NE sides: W4, U2, W6, W7, W8, the jog W8b-W9a, W9, W0. A 4.5 m one-storey strip lies between U2 and W5. walls.json has no walls above the wing roof, so the tower's upper SE and NE faces are given here as U0, U1 and U2 ('upper': true, art ends a/b, z0).

CONFLICT with lhi/facades.json: AHS W5 s 0-9.5 lies on LHI W0's line. AHS EXP (built about 2014-16) covers the old LHI portico plaza, the area (716-722, 474-485) where LHI's spec puts its stucco entrance portico, and its bike rack at (727-731, 486-490): this is now inside the 9.7 m wing (lidar, earth_W5_whole, earth_detail_2a). LHI's W0 entrance, its portico canopy and that rack come from Sep 2014 Street View and should be hidden or dropped. LHI's 'AHS directly N/NE across the portico plaza' is out of date.

BMH: W6 lies within 0.3 m of BMH W12 s 25-36 (BMH 7.5 m tall there). BMH W13 (the old recessed glazed stair face by the LHI plaza) now sits at the joint between AHS W5 b and W6 a, so it is enclosed. BMH W3's 'hidden' bay s 8-18 agrees with AHS's link touching BMH around (711-713, 516-525).

Two short edges are missing from walls.json. (1) W8 b -> W9 a ((711.4,521.9) (712.7,525.1) (710.2,524.2), about 2.6 m) faces NW at the back of the dead-end gap between W9 and BMH W3: brick with a black service door at the top of a short ramp (sv_W0). (2) W5 b -> W6 a ((732.7,479.8) -> (731.4,482.6), about 3 m) is the joint with BMH W13.
W0 stands 1.4 m proud of the W1 line (the vestibule projects past the brick pier), as in walls.json.

W1.notes: Bay widths from earth_W1_whole and earth_W1_l (pier 4.5-5.0 m) and sv_W1_Tx73 (16 storefront panes, about 1.68 m). Storey heights are a compromise: Earth meshes stretch the parapet and SV pitch compresses the top. Brick/siding change on W2 at 8.1 m and NE-face ribbons at 9.9-11.9 and 13.7-15.8 m fix the floor lines at about 4.3 / 8.1 / 12.9 m. Inside the box SV shows from the top: dark vision row, thin band, dark vision row, opaque dark spandrel, thin band, more transparent L2 vision row, dark spandrel. The mullions are about 1.6 m with narrow vent strips; not reproduced. 2014 rendering uw029 agrees.

W2.notes: earth_W2_whole (2024, square-on, 33 px/m) for every s and z: glass slot s 7.4-11, siding from s 11 and above z 7.9-8.1, ribbon s 16.7-29.8 z 8.5-10.8, louvre s 16.6-30.6 z 12.3-16.2, lower glazing s 29.4-38.4. The siding is ribbed horizontally; facade() can do this with 'ribbed' but spec.to_facade does not pass it on.

l2/rib.note: ribbon z 4.9-6.2 with a light sill strip under it, s 3.5-17.3

W3.notes: Only Earth 2024 shows this face (earth_W3_whole about 50 px/m, earth_detail_2c, earth_orbit_000); Street View here is from Sep 2014, before the building. A vertical siding joint runs up from the edge of the corner glazing (s 3.1). The ribbon's sill band (4.65-4.8) is drawn the full width; really it stops at s 3.5 and s 17.3.

W4.summary: SW end of the 2-storey east wing, facing the planter yard: brick for 3 m next to the tower, then 2-storey clear curtain wall that turns the corner onto the wing's glazed SE face
W4.notes: earth_W4_whole, earth_detail_3a, earth_orbit_000 (Earth only, mostly in shade). Whether there is a door into the yard is not visible: guess none. The metal parapet band is light grey like the SE glazed face (earth_W5_whole).

W5.summary: one-storey (4.5 m) strip along the old LHI front: s 0-9.5 is back-to-back with LHI W0 (not visible); s 9.5-17.3 is a low glazed face at the north end of LHI's open-air walkway

ground/glass.note: small glazed face seen only from above (earth_detail_2a, bottom centre, by the purple-leaf maple); probably an entrance from the walkway: guess

W5.notes: Lidar tier 4.5 m, about 3-4 m deep, along this line. LHI's spec still draws W0 as its entrance with a portico in front. That is from Sep 2014 photos, before AHS EXP; see geometry_notes.

W6.summary: east end of the 2-storey wing, back-to-back with BMH W12 s 25-36 (BMH is 7.5 m there); only the top 2.2 m shows, as a light metal parapet over BMH's roof
W6.notes: walls.json puts W6 within 0.3 m of BMH W12. Not seen in any photo; the 2014 sv_W6 shows BMH's own brick and bikes before AHS was built.

W7.summary: angled courtyard return of the east wing: 2-storey curtain wall like W8, light metal parapet
W7.notes: earth_W8_whole left edge and earth_detail_1b left (glazed return with some solid metal panels near the far end). No Street View after 2014.

W8.summary: courtyard face (BMH's curved-path courtyard): 2-storey clear curtain wall with a spandrel line at level 2 and a deep light-grey metal parapet; short brick piece at the b end against BMH
W8.notes: earth_W8_whole, earth_detail_1b, earth_facade_1 (2024). Heavy mullions every few metres with thinner ones between; the 1.5 m pitch is the average. The b-end brick (about 1.5 m) meets BMH's brick tower (BMH W4/W3 corner).

W9.summary: NE side of the entrance link, facing a 2.3-3.7 m dead-end gap to BMH W3: brick ground storey, big clear panes on level 2, grey glass band on top
attached: galvanised-railed ramp in the gap rising to a black service door at the back of the gap (see site.entities)
W9.notes: uw031 (left half: brick below, tall clear panes with pendant lights above) and earth_detail_0c (the link is a narrow 2-storey glass box with a long flat roof running back between AHS and BMH). How far back along the face the level-2 glass runs is not visible: assumed the whole face.

U0.summary: tower's SE face above the east-wing roof: a strip of siding, a full-height glass slot (stair) and a brick corner mass
U0.notes: Line: the tower's SE side from W3 b to the E corner (W1 direction from W2 b, 31.5 m). The slot is at s 1.5-5.3 here, i.e. 21.7-25.5 m along the whole SE side: earth_W5_whole puts it at about 22.8-26.6, earth_W6/earth_orbit_000 at about 17-25. The slot glass runs right up to the roof edge (earth_W5_whole, earth_W6_whole).

U1.summary: tower's NE face above the east wing and entrance link: brick corner masses at both ends, between them siding with two long ribbon windows (levels 3 and 4)
U1.notes: earth_W8_whole (about 43 px/m vertically above the wing roof: ribbons at z 9.9-11.9 and 13.7-15.8), earth_detail_1b, earth_W9_whole, earth_W6_whole. Pier widths ±1.5 m (oblique views). sv_c14 (2025) sees this face's N end edge-on as glazing past the brick corner: consistent with the ribbons. In sun the siding here reads light grey like the SE face.

U2.summary: east wing's upper SE face, set 3-3.6 m behind W5 and standing above the 4.5 m strip and LHI's roof: one storey of clear vertical-mullion curtain wall under a light metal parapet
U2.notes: earth_W5_whole (square-on, about 42 px/m) and earth_detail_2a. The glass turns the SW corner onto W4. Line from the 9.7 m lidar tier edge.
